pages.name: Hukha
pages.text: A large, timid creature that resembles a cat.

pages.title: Taming
pages.text: Hukhas are slow to trust strangers. Offer $(item)raw fish$(), as with cats, and give it time.$(br2)A tamed Hukha follows you; she can be told to sit.

pages.title: Protector
pages.text: A tamed Hukha that is not sitting attacks a $(l:forest/zlyden)Zlydeny$(/l) nearby. A Zlydeny she has struck runs away for about six seconds.$(br2)Mavkas leave hukhas alone.
